name: Four Seasons Hotel Hangzhou
positioning: Garden hotel on the shores of West Lake in Hangzhou, with traditional Jiang Nan architecture
best_for: Travelers who want a garden base on West Lake
Families wanting a family-friendly suite and a Kids for All Seasons program

facts.text: The hotel has 81 rooms in total.
The hotel's address is 5 Lingyin Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou.
The hotel is set along the banks of the fabled West Lake.
The hotel stands on nine private acres of landscaped bamboo forest, lily ponds and gardens.
The architecture is traditional "Jiang Nan" style, with pagoda-style pavilions overlooking a meandering lagoon.
Jin Sha offers traditional Jiangsu-Zhejiang cuisine.
West Lake Bistro is an Italian restaurant.
The Lobby Lounge serves Hangzhou's famous Longjing green tea.
The hotel has a 10 x 19 metres indoor swimming pool.

highlights.text: The hotel offers a 60-minute boat voyage on West Lake aboard an air-conditioned wooden boat.
The spa's signature treatment is the Five Elements Massage.
The One-Bedroom Villa with Private Pool is Song Dynasty-inspired.
The Lagoon Suite is described as a family-friendly suite.

considerations.text: Due to traffic restrictions of odd-even license plates in the West Lake scenic area and hotel surrounds on weekends and statutory holidays, guests should schedule their transportation accordingly.
The hotel is 50-75 minutes by car from Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport.
WhataHotel notes the area can be crowded during peak seasons.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
